# Civic humanism

The name historians give (the notion, coined by Hans Baron, has been debated since) to the Florentine current, from Salutati to Bruni, which made the study of the ancients a preparation for the active life and for service to the republic.

**At stake in** : [The point of philosophy](../axes/metaphilosophy.md) · [Political liberty](../axes/political-liberty.md)

**See also** : [Studia humanitatis](../glossary/studia-humanitatis.md)
